title.narrative: Green Cities 3 W1 - Bishkek District Heating

description.narrative: The provision of a sovereign loan of up to EUR 10.1 million to the Kyrgyz Republic in two tranches (both to be committed at signing) of up to EUR 5.9 million and EUR 4.2 million (the "EBRD Loan"). The funds to be on-lent to the Bishkek city (the "City") for the benefit of Bishkekteploenergo (BTE), a municipal district heating company wholly owned by the City administration to modernize the district heating (DH) infrastructure in Bishkek (the "Project"). The Project will be co-financed by a concessional loan of up to EUR 5.9 million from the Green Climate Fund (the "GCF Loan") under the GCF Green Cities Facility, as well as by an investment grant of up to EUR 4.2 million from an international donor or the EBRD's Shareholder Special Fund (SSF). The EBRD Loan and the GCF Loan will have a tenor of 18 years, including a 4-year grace period under the EBRD Loan and a 6-year grace period under the GCF Loan. Tranche I EBRD Loan and GCF Loan will be disbursed pro-rata. The Project aims to tackle environmental challenges related to Bishkek's worn-out and outdated district energy infrastructure. This is a follow-on investment under the EBRD Green Cities Programme, directly supporting the implementation of energy sector priority actions in the Green City Action Plan (GCAP). Strengthening this critical service will support sustainable urban expansion, enhance living conditions for residents, allow the integration of renewable and waste heat-based heat sources, and align Bishkek with regional and global commitments to sustainable growth.
